preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 1000.
The number of nodes n is between 2 and 1000.
The number of drawings k is exactly 2.

postconditions.expression: return_value[0] == 'YES' if can_recover_tree(n, drawing1, drawing2) else return_value[0] == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The first line of the output is 'YES' if the Tree of Life can be recovered, otherwise 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == n + 1 if return_value[0] == 'YES' else len(return_value) == 1
postconditions.description: If the Tree of Life can be recovered, the output contains n+1 lines, otherwise it contains only one line.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= n and 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= n for line in return_value[1:]) if return_value[0] == 'YES' else True
postconditions.description: Each of the next n lines contains two integers between 1 and n if the Tree of Life can be recovered.
